run_StyleNeRF_training: run a StyleNeRF training job with configurable GPUs, dataset path, and base config spec
setup_training_loop_kwargs: build training loop arguments from a Hydra config including dataset, model, augmentation, and performance options
configure_augmentation_pipeline: configure discriminator augmentation with ada, fixed, or noaug modes and select an augmentation pipe like bgc or bgcfnc
resume_training_from_pkl: resume a StyleNeRF training run from a previously saved network pickle file or predefined transfer learning checkpoint
launch_multi_gpu_training: launch multi-GPU training processes using torch multiprocessing spawn with distributed utilities
